summary: PCA analysis of HAProxy commit 9bc372 (REGTESTS: Fix log matching in healthcheck-section.vtc). Result: 0 compatibility changes found. The patch is a one-line regex fix in a test-only VTC file (reg-tests/checks/healthcheck-section.vtc), changing `srv[0-9]` to `srv[0-9]+` to correctly match multi-digit healthcheck server IDs. Since it's a test-only change with no production code, API, CLI, config, or protocol impact, no directed testing was needed. Analysis worktree has been cleaned up.
